hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the single-variable template K(theta) by replacing theta with p or q while leaving the function symbols G0 and V unchanged.
required_assumptions: G0 and V are unary symbolic functions defined at p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: The two members differ only by the choice of the single variable theta; both are the same product kernel applied to p and q.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the unary function G0 at theta = p or theta = q.
required_assumptions: G0 is a unary symbolic function.
hypotheses.rationale: The two members are evaluations of the same named function G0 at different symbolic points.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the unary function V at theta = p or theta = q.
required_assumptions: V is a unary symbolic function.
hypotheses.rationale: The two members are evaluations of the same named function V at different symbolic points.
